messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I ordered some things for my daughter recently, but she hasn't received them yet. Could you help me check which address the order was sent to, the tracking number, and if it's still on the way? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered. And, if possible, I'd like to set my daughter's address as my default for future orders, so I don't have to keep changing it.

Sure—I can help with all of that, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Then, to check the shipment details and tracking, please also send:
- The **order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`) for your daughter’s order

And for the tablet storage question:
- The **tablet product name** (or the **product ID** if you have it), and/or the **item id** from the order details

I actually don't remember my email address right now, but my name is Lucas Santos and my ZIP code is 80239. 

As for the order ID and the tablet info, I don't have them on hand at the moment—sorry about that. Is there any way you could look up my recent orders using my name and ZIP code? I just want to make sure my daughter in Chicago gets her things. 

By the way, thanks for helping me out. I don't get to talk to many people these days, so I appreciate you taking the time.
